svg.title: One Q4_0 block of 32 weights: scale, levels, and reconstruction for the first 8 values

text.tspan: One Q4_0 block, first 8 of 32 weights
Scale: largest |w| is 0.91 (element 14). d = 0.91 / -8 = -0.11375, stored as FP16 -0.11377.
Level: q = min(15, trunc(w / d + 8.5)). Rebuilt: w′ = (q - 8) x d.
